erin_dev: Heads up - noticed preview spikes for tenant t-314 around 2026-03-25T09:00 UTC. Preview shows ~1.8M tokens, ledger stays ~900k. Suspect double-counts from shadowed edge plus clock-skew duplication.
maya_ops: can you paste a tiny example of raw nearline events?
erin_dev: yes: 
2026-03-25T08:59:59.990Z ingest-nearline tenant=t-314 fp=fpZ tokens=450 event=e-aaa
2026-03-25T09:00:00.011Z ingest-nearline tenant=t-314 fp=fpZ|shadow tokens=450 event=e-aaa
Both written; preview groups on "fp||tenant||hour" so both survive. Ledger dedupes by event id so invoices fine.
raj_platform: two problem vectors: shadow mutates fingerprint and worker clocks differ by milliseconds. Two mitigations: normalize fingerprint by stripping shadow tag before preview grouping; and enforce an idempotent upsert by event id at nearline write. Upsert is heavier but correct.
sara_billing: billing prefers minimal UX churn. Proposal: 1) quick fix: add preview_meta.sources_included array in preview API so UI can surface whether shadowed rows were counted; 2) medium: strip shadow tag in preview normalizer; 3) long: enable nearline upsert-by-event for canary tenants.
maya_ops: rollout plan: strip-shadow-tag in nearline normalizer behind flag preview_strip_shadow=true first. Add API param ?include_shadow=true/false so UI can toggle. If that doesn't reduce noise, roll upsert-by-event with sampling (5% -> 25% -> 100%).
erin_dev: support needs a short blurb and a console banner: "Preview may include shadowed or transient duplicates; final invoice unaffected." Also a quick debug endpoint to fetch "aligned preview" for support.
support-bot: [automated] Created ticket BP-4455: "preview strip-shadow + optional upsert dedupe" assigned to raj_platform, maya_ops. Link: https://issues.redwood.ai/BP-4455
raj_platform: will add telemetry metrics preview_shadow_tokens and preview_clock_dup_ratio. Add an alert if preview_shadow_tokens > 20% of preview_total for top tenants.
maya_ops: locking owners: raj_platform -> normalization flag + telemetry, maya_ops -> sampling + rollout orchestration, sara_billing -> API meta + support copy, erin_dev -> console banner + debug endpoint. Sync in #eng-platform-ops in 20m.
